meta.title: AI reading room
meta.description: Read and reflect with AI. Enable the plugin and open AI reading room in the sidebar to import EPUB, PDF, TXT or Markdown. Right-click passages for five-color highlights or underlines, with undo/redo, source-linked notes, filters and Markdown export. Bookworm offers chat, question-led reading, teach-back, perspective debate and editable personal methods, alongside focus reading and explicitly requested reviews. Model calls occur only when you send or generate; relevant excerpts and selected notes/discussion material go to your configured service. Includes a bilingual guide and local backups. Disabling preserves the local library and records. OCR, MOBI/AZW3, cross-book topics and automatic reminders are not included.
